It is a local review candidate, not a published or operational release. [Current scope](RELEASE_NOTES_1.38.0.md). Both predecessor PRs retain their own checks and evidence. The complete integrated source, canonical and mirror pages, source catalog, cache workers and package identities need fresh qualification. Every existing full-software workflow, security, recovery, accessibility, exact-main, saved-package, public-byte and publication gate remains. No historical green result qualifies changed bytes, and no branch is cleared while required checks are pending. The **1.37.1** discussion below remains the paper predecessor's dated scope. Its original documents, original PDF/TEX bytes and historical tags/assets remain unchanged. No mainnet transaction, signing, funding, activation, settlement or live paid work is authorized by this software candidate. ## Existing CRLF checkout upgrade for this 1.38.0 source Adding LF attributes does not rewrite unchanged files in an existing `core.autocrlf=true` checkout. After updating this source, explicitly inspect the fixed capability closure before generating or validating: ```bash python scripts/refresh_capability_checkout.py ``` For this version only, the helper authenticates the catalogue and all **49** fixed source/generated files against the reviewed `644258ac21cc938aff861d02ad728e8f3c9716f6ea78700acc35e4d7400eebf2` source identity. The default command writes nothing. If it reports `needsRefresh`, close editors and other processes writing to this checkout, choose an existing backup parent **outside** the checkout, and explicitly apply: ```bash python scripts/refresh_capability_checkout.py --apply --backup-parent /existing/external/backup-parent ``` All 49 working files must first match their exact pinned LF bytes or their uniform CRLF equivalents. Private content edits, mixed line endings, missing/oversized files and symlinked file paths refuse the whole plan before backup or source writes. Preserve and review meaningful edits separately; this is a version-bound working-file normalization tool, not a general renormalizer or source-acceptance check. It does not inspect, change or discard staged edits, the Git index/configuration, unlisted files or original PDF/TEX papers. It never runs Git, a generator or repository code, and generation does not invoke it automatically. Apply creates a new private `capability-lf-backup-*` directory with every original raw body and a SHA-256, size and mode manifest, then rechecks the inputs before replacing only affected files with pinned LF bytes. Retain that backup and the printed result. An interrupted operation may be partial: the backup remains, `result.json` records completed replacements when possible, and there is no automatic rollback or durability claim. Stop on an error and inspect the retained originals before another action. With no concurrent edits, a successful repair preserves file modes; a second check reports no refresh needed. Native Windows generation has separate qualification requirements; this repair does not establish a release, browser or runtime pass. ## Preserved paper predecessor readiness record ## Release readiness — 1.37.1 combined software candidate Version **1.37.1** combines the existing capability/Out-Evolve source, the bounded OUT-EXECUTE implementation, seven original featured papers and the simpler paper-publication lane. The [release notes](RELEASE_NOTES_1.37.1.md) describe the scope, explicit synthetic assumptions, equal/cheaper baselines and inert Jobs/Fleet drafts. The owner approved superseding the unpublished 1.37.0 candidate with this combined next source. This is a full software qualification, not a documentation-only or paper-overlay release. All original PDF/TEX bytes, historical records, contracts, payment routes and authority boundaries are preserved. Version 1.37.1 was unused when prepared. Never reuse or move a published tag or replace published assets; verify live version availability again before publication. The 1.37.0 proposal below remains historical, not a claim that it was published. The authored local study is source-bound evidence, not exact-release acceptance or reproduction of the manuscript's missing companion archive. The complete capability workflow is now a required Agent release dependency, including exact source/generated identity, actual finite computation, recovery, browser and accessibility evidence. Fresh integrated PR checks/review, authorized merge, exact-main historical CI and Agent acceptance, security, packaging, public HTTPS and uploaded-byte checks are required. Paper-only checks cannot qualify this runtime/workflow change. Local browser and Semgrep limitations remain disclosed, not bypassed. Future verified paper-only descendants may use the separate [paper-publication lane](PAPER_UPLOADS.md), preserving the immutable tested software identity and adding explicit paper-site provenance. They do not mutate release assets or qualify new runtime code. Consult the matching manifest and reports to establish actual delivery; previous source records below retain their original scope. ## Existing public links The combined release must retain the 997 currently published file paths: 991 original v1.36.0 paths, five additive original PDF copies, and the historical PDF-repair receipt. Automated accessibility checks and responsive layouts still need to be complemented by usability studies with older and nontechnical participants, additional browsers and assistive technologies. ## Recover a release workflow after a retry 1. Open the failed job and identify its actual error. A historical-CI waiting timeout does not mean the test suites failed: inspect the separate CI, PR CI and Smoke runs for the same full commit SHA. 2. Wait for every required run on that commit to complete successfully. Repair a test failure through a reviewed source change; the new main commit must pass its own checks. 3. For a timing-only failure, use **Re-run failed jobs** on the original release workflow. Successful test jobs retain their evidence. The historical waiter rechecks all three required workflows. 4. Confirm packaging, public Pages acceptance and publication all succeed. A successful test run alone does not establish that the public website or release assets have been published. The Agent Release regression job allows 90 minutes for the complete locked test suite, cold strict-type checks and repository validation. Test commands, coverage requirements and functional runtime deadlines are unchanged. The historical CI waiter retains its separate 120-minute bounded wait and 125-minute enclosing job, reserving five minutes for evidence upload and cleanup. Its wait accommodates runner queues and the existing execution limits of CI, PR CI and Smoke workflows. Deadlines still fail closed: successful tests cannot replace an incomplete job. The successful waiter supplies its unique attempt-specific artifact name to packaging, and the download verifies its SHA-256 digest. The report must identify the same commit and successful main-push runs of every required workflow. Packaging rejects missing, failed or stale reports. Package and public-site evidence downloads also use the producing job's unique artifact name. Artifact IDs are opaque identifiers: a larger number does not prove a newer attempt. Earlier attempt artifacts remain available as diagnostic history. ## Upgrade without losing your work 1. Pause the old agent. Verify its journal, make a private backup, and retain its checksum and journal head separately. Keep its existing environment and state directory. 2. No Git command, index/configuration change or generator runs here. Unexpected
content refuses the entire plan; original raw bytes stay in a private backup.

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import stat
import tempfile
from typing import TypedDict

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
CATALOG = "docs/successor/capabilities/sources.json"
SOURCE_HASH = "644258ac21cc938aff861d02ad728e8f3c9716f6ea78700acc35e4d7400eebf2"
MAX_FILE_BYTES = 8 * 1024 * 1024
MAX_TOTAL_BYTES = 32 * 1024 * 1024
# Reviewed canonical bytes. The catalogue digest authenticates all 41 source
# paths/hashes, so an edited catalogue cannot choose its own repair targets.
EXTRA_FILES = {
    "examples/successor-capability/discovery-lab-reproduce.mjs": (
        7903,
        "21aabff4e543789f6ddbc074fcf7e0a3ea706cada55345f680f4edcb7afac894",

    ),
    "docs/alpha_factory_v1/demos/successor/capabilities/index.html": (

    "docs/service-worker.js": (23275, "fb8fd61467254b4af045443aa5f0575259b26129290958bf667c67a7deda75bb"),
    "docs/assets/service-worker.js": (23707, "d2b72a7115364078ab7c2212fab53c43452e8af6d644d1a16926c61a594619b0"),
    "docs/alpha_factory_v1/demos/alpha_agi_insight_v1/service-worker.js": (
        26299,
        "0b067ee54afeea5a22b7737deb752168d5d2ff6a4d7404a406579ea3f79df247",
    ),
}


class Record(TypedDict):
    path: str
    raw: bytes
    canonical: bytes
    status: os.stat_result


class RefreshResult(TypedDict):
    schema: str
    sourceHash: str
    checked: int
    needsRefresh: list[str]
    applied: bool
    backupDirectory: str | None


def _hash(raw: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()


def _read(root: Path, name: str) -> tuple[bytes, os.stat_result]:
    parts = PurePosixPath(name).parts
    if not parts or name != "/".join(parts) or any(p in {"", ".", ".."} for p in parts) or "\\" in name:
        raise ValueError("Invalid fixed capability path")
    if PurePosixPath(name).is_absolute():
        raise ValueError("Absolute capability path")
    path = root
    for part in parts[:-1]:
        path /= part
        if not stat.S_ISDIR(path.lstat().st_mode):
            raise ValueError("Capability parent must be a direct directory: " + name)
    path /= parts[-1]
    before = path.lstat()
    if not stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) or before.st_size > MAX_FILE_BYTES:
        raise ValueError("Capability input must be a bounded regular file: " + name)
    descriptor = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | getattr(os, "O_NOFOLLOW", 0) | getattr(os, "O_NONBLOCK", 0))
    with os.fdopen(descriptor, "rb") as stream:
        opened = os.fstat(stream.fileno())
        if not stat.S_ISREG(opened.st_mode) or (opened.st_dev, opened.st_ino) != (before.st_dev, before.st_ino):
            raise ValueError("Capability input changed while opening: " + name)
        raw = stream.read(MAX_FILE_BYTES + 1)
    if len(raw) > MAX_FILE_BYTES:
        raise ValueError("Capability input exceeds repair bound: " + name)
    return raw, opened


def _canonical(raw: bytes, expected: str, size: int | None, name: str) -> bytes:
    canonical = raw.replace(b"\r\n", b"\n")
    if b"\r" in canonical or _hash(canonical) != expected or size is not None and len(canonical) != size:
        raise ValueError("Private or unexpected capability bytes; nothing refreshed: " + name)
    if raw not in {canonical, canonical.replace(b"\n", b"\r\n")}:
        raise ValueError("Mixed line endings require manual review; nothing refreshed: " + name)
    return canonical


def _fingerprint(value: os.stat_result) -> tuple[int, ...]:
    return (value.st_dev, value.st_ino, value.st_size, value.st_mtime_ns, value.st_mode, value.st_uid, value.st_gid)


def _unchanged(root: Path, records: list[Record]) -> None:
    for record in records:
        raw, status = _read(root, record["path"])
        if raw != record["raw"] or _fingerprint(status) != _fingerprint(record["status"]):
            raise ValueError("Checkout changed during repair; stop and retain backup: " + record["path"])


def refresh(root: Path = ROOT, *, apply: bool = False, backup_parent: Path | None = None) -> RefreshResult:
    """Check the complete closed49 before any backup or canonical-byte replacement."""
    root = root.resolve(strict=True)
    catalog_raw, _ = _read(root, CATALOG)
    catalog_bytes = _canonical(catalog_raw, EXTRA_FILES[CATALOG][1], EXTRA_FILES[CATALOG][0], CATALOG)
    catalog = json.loads(catalog_bytes)
    sources = catalog["sources"]
    if (
        catalog["schema"] != "successor-capability-source/v1"
        or len(sources) != 41
        or catalog["sourceHash"] != SOURCE_HASH
        or _hash(json.dumps(sources, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode()) != SOURCE_HASH
    ):
        raise ValueError("Unsupported capability source identity")
    expected: dict[str, tuple[int | None, str]] = {name: (None, digest) for name, digest in sources.items()}
    expected.update(EXTRA_FILES)
    if len(expected) != 49:
        raise ValueError("Unsupported capability repair closure")
    records: list[Record] = []
    for name, (size, digest) in sorted(expected.items()):
        raw, status = _read(root, name)
        canonical = _canonical(raw, digest, size, name)
        records.append({"path": name, "raw": raw, "canonical": canonical, "status": status})
    if sum(len(r["raw"]) for r in records) > MAX_TOTAL_BYTES:
        raise ValueError("Capability repair exceeds total bound")
    changed = [r for r in records if r["raw"] != r["canonical"]]
    result: RefreshResult = {
        "schema": "capability-lf-checkout-refresh/v1",
        "sourceHash": SOURCE_HASH,
        "checked": 49,
        "needsRefresh": [r["path"] for r in changed],
        "applied": False,
        "backupDirectory": None,
    }
    if not apply or not changed:
        result["applied"] = apply
        return result
    parent = (backup_parent or Path(tempfile.gettempdir())).resolve(strict=True)
    if not parent.is_dir() or parent == root or parent.is_relative_to(root):
        raise ValueError("Choose an existing backup parent outside the checkout")
    _unchanged(root, records)
    backup = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="capability-lf-backup-", dir=parent))
    backup.chmod(0o700)
    backup_files: list[dict[str, str | int]] = []
    manifest = {"schema": "capability-lf-original-backup/v1", "sourceHash": SOURCE_HASH, "files": backup_files}
    # Every original is retained before staging or replacing any checkout file.
    for record in records:
        destination = backup / "files" / record["path"]
        destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with destination.open("xb") as stream:
            stream.write(record["raw"])
        destination.chmod(0o600)
        backup_files.append(
            {
                "path": record["path"],
                "bytes": len(record["raw"]),
                "sha256": _hash(record["raw"]),
                "mode": stat.S_IMODE(record["status"].st_mode),
            }
        )
    (backup / "manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    staged: list[tuple[Record, Path]] = []
    applied: list[str] = []
    try:
        _unchanged(root, records)
        for record in changed:
            target = root / record["path"]
            descriptor, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix="." + target.name + ".lf-", dir=target.parent)
            staged.append((record, Path(temporary)))
            with os.fdopen(descriptor, "wb") as stream:
                stream.write(record["canonical"])
                stream.flush()
                os.fsync(stream.fileno())
                if hasattr(os, "fchmod"):
                    os.fchmod(stream.fileno(), stat.S_IMODE(record["status"].st_mode))
            if not hasattr(os, "fchmod"):
                Path(temporary).chmod(stat.S_IMODE(record["status"].st_mode))
        _unchanged(root, records)
        for record, temporary in staged:
            raw, status = _read(root, record["path"])
            if raw != record["raw"] or _fingerprint(status) != _fingerprint(record["status"]):
                raise ValueError("Checkout changed during repair: " + record["path"])
            os.replace(temporary, root / record["path"])
            applied.append(record["path"])
    except (OSError, ValueError) as error:
        (backup / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps({"applied": applied, "complete": False}) + "\n")
        raise RuntimeError("Refresh stopped; original bytes retained at " + str(backup)) from error
    finally:
        for _, temporary in staged:
            temporary.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    (backup / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps({"applied": applied, "complete": True}) + "\n")
    result.update(applied=True, backupDirectory=str(backup))
    return result


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--root", type=Path, default=ROOT)
    parser.add_argument(
        "--apply", action="store_true", help="Explicitly refresh only prevalidated CRLF capability files"
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--backup-parent", type=Path, help="Existing external directory for a new private retained backup"
    )
    arguments = parser.parse_args()
    print(json.dumps(refresh(arguments.root, apply=arguments.apply, backup_parent=arguments.backup_parent), indent=2))

def load_script(name: str) -> ModuleType:
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, ROOT / "scripts" / f"{name}.py")
    assert spec is not None and spec.loader is not None
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module

def test_acceptance_is_mandatory_read_only_and_retains_evidence() -> None:
    workflow = yaml.safe_load((ROOT / ".github/workflows/successor-capability.yml").read_text())
    assert workflow["permissions"] == {"contents": "read"}
    assert workflow["concurrency"]["group"].startswith("capability-")
    # Standalone and reusable release invocations must not cancel one another.
    assert "${{ github.workflow }}" in workflow["concurrency"]["group"]
    job = workflow["jobs"]["capability"]
    assert job["if"] == "${{ !cancelled() && success() && needs.paper-scope.outputs.mode == 'full' }}"
    assert job["needs"] == "paper-scope"
    assert workflow["jobs"]["paper-scope"]["uses"] == "./.github/workflows/paper-scope.yml"
    assert not job.get("continue-on-error")
    steps = job["steps"]
    for step in steps:
        if "uses" in step:
            assert re.fullmatch(r"[^@]+@[0-9a-f]{40}", step["uses"])
    commands = [
        "node --test examples/successor-capability/*.test.mjs",
        "python scripts/generate_successor_capability.py",
        "git diff --exit-code -- docs/successor/capabilities",
        "python tests/browser/test_successor_capability_browser.py",
    ]
    for command in commands:
        matches = [step for step in steps if command in step.get("run", "")]
        assert len(matches) == 1
        assert "if" not in matches[0] and not matches[0].get("continue-on-error")
    browser = next(step for step in steps if commands[-1] in step.get("run", ""))
    assert browser["env"]["AXE_SCRIPT"].endswith("/tests/browser/node_modules/axe-core/axe.min.js")
    retained = {
        commands[0]: "node.log",
        "tests/test_successor_capability_delivery.py -q": "delivery.log",
        "python -m mypy --strict": "typing.log",
        commands[-1]: "v1-browser.log",
        "python tests/browser/test_out_evolve_browser.py": "out-evolve-browser.log",
        "python tests/browser/test_out_execute_browser.py": "out-execute-browser.log",
        "node examples/successor-capability/out-execute/reproduce.mjs": "out-execute-study.log",
        "python tests/browser/test_successor_capability_accessibility.py": "accessibility-review.log",
    }
    for command, log in retained.items():
        step = next(step for step in steps if command in step.get("run", ""))
        assert "set -o pipefail" in step["run"]
        assert f"tee capability-evidence/logs/{log}" in step["run"]
        assert "if" not in step and not step.get("continue-on-error")
    typing = next(step["run"] for step in steps if "python -m mypy --strict" in step.get("run", ""))
    assert "tests/browser/out_evolve_recovery.py" in typing
    assert "tests/browser/test_out_execute_browser.py" in typing
    events = workflow.get("on", workflow.get(True))
    assert "tests/browser/out_evolve_recovery.py" in events["pull_request"]["paths"]
    assert "tests/browser/test_out_execute_browser.py" in events["pull_request"]["paths"]
    # This data file is consumed executable input in the generated browser bundle.
    assert "docs/discovery-lab/DEPLOYMENT_COMPATIBILITY.json" in events["pull_request"]["paths"]
    assert "workflow_call" in events
    node_step = next(step["run"] for step in steps if "node --test" in step.get("run", ""))
    assert "examples/successor-capability/out-execute/*.test.mjs" in node_step
    uploader = next(step for step in steps if step.get("uses", "").startswith("actions/upload-artifact@"))
    assert uploader["if"] == "always()"
    assert uploader["with"]["if-no-files-found"] == "error"

# These fixtures use only ordinary owned Git checkouts and data-only old bodies.
# The retained parent reproducer is never executed.
def _refresh_copy(tmp_path: Path) -> Path:
    root = tmp_path / "checkout"
    for name in capability_checkout_paths():
        target = root / name
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        target.write_bytes((ROOT / name).read_bytes().replace(b"\n", b"\r\n"))
    return root


def _git(root: Path, *arguments: str) -> bytes:
    return subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(root), *arguments], capture_output=True, check=True).stdout


def test_existing_parent_to_lf_attributes_checkout_has_explicit_backed_up_repair(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    """A normal upgrade leaves stale raw CRLF despite clean Git status and LF attributes."""
    helper = load_script("refresh_capability_checkout")
    paths = capability_checkout_paths()
    fixture = json.loads((ROOT / "tests/fixtures/capability-checkout-parent.json").read_bytes())
    assert fixture["sourceCommit"] == "87a003d23d3093edac3747ee1f9da292c6159515"
    assert fixture["sourceTree"] == "ffa3d663519e713eca31a9840b8bf6816e53e12a"
    source, checkout = tmp_path / "source", tmp_path / "checkout"
    source.mkdir()
    controls = ["docs/Out_Execute.tex", "docs/Out_Execute.pdf"]
    for name in [*paths, *controls]:
        target = source / name
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        target.write_bytes((ROOT / name).read_bytes())
    (source / "unpinned-control.txt").write_bytes(b"ordinary control\n")
    for name, entry in fixture["files"].items():
        raw = entry["text"].encode()
        assert len(raw) == entry["bytes"] and hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == entry["sha256"]
        (source / name).write_bytes(raw)
    for arguments in (
        ("init", "--quiet"),
        ("config", "user.name", "Owned test"),
        ("config", "user.email", "owned-test@example.invalid"),
        ("config", "commit.gpgsign", "false"),
        ("add", "."),
        ("commit", "--quiet", "-m", "Exact old attribute and reproducer bodies"),
    ):
        _git(source, *arguments)
    parent = _git(source, "rev-parse", "HEAD").decode().strip()
    for name in fixture["files"]:
        (source / name).write_bytes((ROOT / name).read_bytes())
    _git(source, "add", ".")
    _git(source, "commit", "--quiet", "-m", "Reviewed LF attribute transition")
    target = _git(source, "rev-parse", "HEAD").decode().strip()
    subprocess.run(
        ["git", "clone", "--quiet", "--local", "--no-checkout", str(source), str(checkout)],
        capture_output=True,
        check=True,
    )
    _git(checkout, "config", "core.autocrlf", "true")
    _git(checkout, "config", "core.eol", "crlf")
    _git(checkout, "checkout", "--quiet", "--detach", parent)
    _git(checkout, "checkout", "--quiet", "--detach", target)
    assert _git(checkout, "status", "--porcelain") == b""
    (checkout / "private-staged.txt").write_bytes(b"private staged content\n")
    _git(checkout, "add", "private-staged.txt")
    originals = {name: (checkout / name).read_bytes() for name in paths}
    modes = {name: stat.S_IMODE((checkout / name).stat().st_mode) for name in paths}
    unchanged = {
        name: (checkout / name).read_bytes()
        for name in [*controls, "unpinned-control.txt", "private-staged.txt", ".git/index", ".git/config"]
    }
    assert unchanged["unpinned-control.txt"] == b"ordinary control\r\n"
    assert sum(b"\r\n" in raw for raw in originals.values()) == 47
    catalog = json.loads(originals[helper.CATALOG])
    assert (
        sum(hashlib.sha256(originals[name]).hexdigest() != digest for name, digest in catalog["sources"].items()) == 40
    )
    dry_run = helper.refresh(checkout)
    assert dry_run["checked"] == 49 and len(dry_run["needsRefresh"]) == 47
    assert not dry_run["applied"] and dry_run["backupDirectory"] is None
    assert originals == {name: (checkout / name).read_bytes() for name in paths}
    backup_parent = tmp_path / "backups"
    backup_parent.mkdir()
    applied = helper.refresh(checkout, apply=True, backup_parent=backup_parent)
    backup = Path(applied["backupDirectory"])
    assert applied["applied"] and stat.S_IMODE(backup.stat().st_mode) == 0o700
    manifest = json.loads((backup / "manifest.json").read_bytes())
    assert len(manifest["files"]) == 49
    for entry in manifest["files"]:
        name = entry["path"]
        assert (backup / "files" / name).read_bytes() == originals[name]
        assert entry["bytes"] == len(originals[name])
        assert entry["sha256"] == hashlib.sha256(originals[name]).hexdigest()
        assert entry["mode"] == modes[name] == stat.S_IMODE((checkout / name).stat().st_mode)
        assert (checkout / name).read_bytes() == (ROOT / name).read_bytes()
    assert unchanged == {name: (checkout / name).read_bytes() for name in unchanged}
    # Index bytes/stat metadata stay untouched; raw working bytes are the repair contract.
    assert _git(checkout, "diff", "--exit-code") == b""
    assert helper.refresh(checkout, apply=True, backup_parent=backup_parent)["backupDirectory"] is None
    assert list(backup_parent.iterdir()) == [backup]


@pytest.mark.parametrize("edit", ["private", "mixed", "catalog", "oversize"])
def test_checkout_refresh_refuses_the_whole_plan_for_unexpected_bytes(tmp_path: Path, edit: str) -> None:
    helper = load_script("refresh_capability_checkout")
    root = _refresh_copy(tmp_path)
    path = root / (helper.CATALOG if edit == "catalog" else "scripts/generate_successor_capability.py")
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    if edit == "mixed":
        path.write_bytes(raw.replace(b"\r\n", b"\n", 1))
    elif edit == "oversize":
        with path.open("wb") as stream:
            stream.truncate(helper.MAX_FILE_BYTES + 1)
    else:
        path.write_bytes(raw + b"private edit\r\n")
    originals = {name: (root / name).read_bytes() for name in capability_checkout_paths()}
    backups = tmp_path / "backups"
    backups.mkdir()
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        helper.refresh(root, apply=True, backup_parent=backups)
    assert originals == {name: (root / name).read_bytes() for name in originals}
    assert list(backups.iterdir()) == []


def test_checkout_refresh_refuses_aliases_and_inside_backup_before_changes(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    helper = load_script("refresh_capability_checkout")
    root = _refresh_copy(tmp_path)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="outside"):
        helper.refresh(root, apply=True, backup_parent=root)
    catalog = root / helper.CATALOG
    saved = catalog.read_bytes()
    outside = tmp_path / "original-catalog.json"
    outside.write_bytes(saved)
    catalog.unlink()
    catalog.symlink_to(outside)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="regular"):
        helper.refresh(root, apply=True, backup_parent=tmp_path)
    assert outside.read_bytes() == saved
    assert not list(tmp_path.glob("capability-lf-backup-*"))


def test_checkout_refresh_retains_all_originals_on_replace_failure(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    helper = load_script("refresh_capability_checkout")
    root = _refresh_copy(tmp_path)
    originals = {name: (root / name).read_bytes() for name in capability_checkout_paths()}
    backups = tmp_path / "backups"
    backups.mkdir()

    def unavailable_replace(*arguments: object) -> None:
        raise OSError("ordinary unavailable destination fixture")

    monkeypatch.setattr(helper.os, "replace", unavailable_replace)
    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="original bytes retained"):
        helper.refresh(root, apply=True, backup_parent=backups)
    (backup,) = backups.iterdir()
    assert json.loads((backup / "result.json").read_bytes()) == {"applied": [], "complete": False}
    assert originals == {name: (root / name).read_bytes() for name in originals}
    assert originals == {name: (backup / "files" / name).read_bytes() for name in originals}
    assert not [path for path in root.rglob(".*") if ".lf-" in path.name]
